name: harness-ship
description: Test and release confidence for AI coding agents: advise the next cuts, plan the evidence, explore before automating, verify the exact artifact, and keep release human-owned.

interface.longDescription: Choose effective tests from current scope, existing coverage, and real risks. Explore runnable features, add useful regression coverage, test the actual candidate, and assess release evidence in one concise summary. Reusable Test Contracts are optional; release remains human-owned.
defaultPrompt: Set up harness-ship for this repository.
Advise what this project should test next.
Plan proportionate verification for this change.
Explore this runnable feature before adding the minimum sufficient automated coverage.
Test this candidate using current scope and existing coverage.
Run the release gate for this candidate.
